title: Odd Semester 2026–27 Begins
description: The academic odd semester for 2026–27 begins on 15 July 2026. All departments resume classes. Students should collect their timetables from the respective departments.

title: First Year Orientation Program
description: Orientation for first-year students is conducted on 16–17 July 2026 at RV Block Seminar Hall 1. Parents are welcome on Day 1.

title: Last Date for Fee Payment — Semester 1
description: Final date to pay semester fees without late penalty. Pay at the Accounts Office, RV Block, Ground Floor.

title: Last Date for Fee Payment — Sem 3/5/7
description: Fee payment deadline for second, third, and fourth-year students.

title: Club Registration Deadline
description: Last date for students to register for college clubs and associations for the 2026–27 academic year.

title: Internal Assessment 1
description: First internal assessment examinations for all departments. Schedule will be published by the Exam Cell.

title: Independence Day Holiday
description: Independence Day national holiday. Campus remains open but no academic activities.

title: Project Abstract Submission
description: Third-year students must submit mini-project abstracts to their respective HODs by 15 September 2026.

title: Internal Assessment 2
description: Second internal assessment examinations for all departments.

title: Project Report Submission — Final Year
description: Final-year students must submit their project reports to the department before this date.

title: Internal Assessment 3 / Model Exam
description: Third internal assessment and model exams. Results will determine exam eligibility.

title: Semester End Examinations
description: End-semester university examinations begin on 23 November 2026. Hall tickets will be issued one week prior by the Exam Cell.

title: Winter Vacation
description: Winter vacation for all students. Campus security and hostel operations continue.

title: Even Semester 2026–27 Begins
description: The even semester begins on 6 January 2027.

title: Hostel Application Deadline — Even Semester
description: Students wishing to apply for hostel accommodation for the even semester must submit applications by this date.

title: Even Semester Ends
description: The even semester ends with completion of practical exams. Results expected within 60 days.
